description: Public-safe daily repository scan. Evidence values and source excerpts are never emitted.

secretRules.summary: Private key material may be present.
secretRules.recommendation: Revoke or rotate the key, remove it from history, and use a local secret store.

secretRules.summary: A GitHub token-shaped value may be present.
secretRules.recommendation: Revoke the token and replace it with an encrypted repository secret.

secretRules.summary: An AWS access-key-shaped value may be present.
secretRules.recommendation: Disable the credential, investigate its use, and move credentials to a secret store.

secretRules.summary: A long credential-shaped assignment may be present.
secretRules.recommendation: Confirm this is not a live credential and use an encrypted secret store if it is.
